name: nostrodomus
description: Context-aware autocomplete, snippets, and syntax styling for Home Assistant's card and YAML editors
author: Views2k

scripts.gate: npm run lint && npm run typecheck && npm run check:modules && npm test && python3 tools/build.py && python3 tools/verify.py --release && npm run verify:reproducible && python3 tools/validate_snippets.py
scripts.e2e:up: node tools/e2e/ensure_state.mjs && docker compose -f tools/e2e/docker-compose.yml up -d --wait && node tools/e2e/bootstrap.mjs && node tools/e2e/seed.mjs
scripts.e2e:beta: HA_STATE=.ha-state-beta node tools/e2e/ensure_state.mjs && HA_TAG=beta HA_STATE=.ha-state-beta docker compose -f tools/e2e/docker-compose.yml up -d --wait && HA_STATE=.ha-state-beta node tools/e2e/bootstrap.mjs && HA_STATE=.ha-state-beta node tools/e2e/seed.mjs && HA_STATE=.ha-state-beta playwright test --config tests/e2e/playwright.config.mjs
scripts.lint: eslint src tools tests eslint.config.js --quiet && node tools/check_lint_coverage.mjs
scripts.lint:full: eslint src tools tests eslint.config.js && node tools/check_lint_coverage.mjs
